note: Built from the Putnam County Supervisor of Elections' candidate listing, offices-up-for-election page, official August 18 primary results and elected-officials roster, plus the state judicial candidate list; sample ballots are offered only through a personal voter lookup, so they were not checked. County commissioners are elected countywide: in the August Republican primary for District 4, every Republican in the county could vote, and Larry Harvey defeated Joseph "Joey" Agner. Not on the November ballot: County Commission District 2 (Leota Wilkinson, unopposed), School Board Districts 1, 4 and 5 (unopposed), and all 7th Judicial Circuit seats (unopposed). Not shown: Palatka City Commission Groups 2 and 4 (Jamaad C. Batts, Sr. and James Norwood, Jr.; Justin Campbell and Breanna Pierce), because whether they are elected citywide could not be confirmed (the Palatka mayor's race was decided in August); Pomona Park mayor; and Soil and Water Conservation District seats. County and city referenda could not be checked and are not shown. Check your official sample ballot.
